target: USPS: Your parcel cannot be delivered. Update address within 24 hours at https://usps-track.top/redeliver

indicators.name: Artificial Time Pressure (Urgent / 24h)
indicators.description: Attackers create urgent psychological pressure to rush victims into bypassing rational scrutiny.

indicators.name: Postal / Courier Brand Impersonation
indicators.description: Impersonating postal couriers or toll authorities with missing parcel lures is a major smishing vector.

explanation: The target exhibits 2 elevated threat markers according to the PhishGuard heuristic and logistic regression baseline classifier.
recommendedActions: Do NOT open the link or enter sensitive credentials.
Do not reply or provide 2FA tokens, gift cards, or wire transfers.
Navigate directly to the official organization website by typing the verified URL in your browser.
Report the indicator to your organization’s Security Operations Center (SOC).
uncertaintyCaveat: DISCLAIMER: Threat classification models evaluate structural, lexical, and behavioral markers. Zero-day attacks and legitimate compromised infrastructure may appear benign. Conversely, novel benign sites may trigger statistical false positives.

target: USPS Notice: Your package 940011189922 could not be delivered due to an incorrect house number. Update your details within 24 hours at https://us-postal-redeliver.top/tracking to prevent return to sender.

indicators.name: Artificial 24-Hour Time Pressure
indicators.description: Imposes short deadline to panic the victim into immediate action without verification.

indicators.name: Postal Delivery Impersonation
indicators.description: Classic courier redelivery scam requesting personal address and credit card fee.

indicators.name: Suspicious TLD in Link
indicators.description: Extracted link uses .top domain rather than official usps.com.

explanation: Standard mass-delivery smishing scam designed to harvest credit cards and personal identities under the guise of redelivering a fictitious postal parcel.
recommendedActions: Do not click the link or pay any redelivery fee.
Forward SMS to 7726 (SPAM) for carrier-level blocking.
uncertaintyCaveat: Verified smishing pattern with unauthorized lookalike courier domain.

explanation: Official repository hosted on legitimate github.com domain. No suspicious lexical, typosquatting, or redirection markers detected.
recommendedActions: Ensure HTTPS connection remains verified by your browser certificate validator.
uncertaintyCaveat: Target domain is verified, but remember that legitimate platforms can occasionally host malicious third-party user uploads.

target: URGENT: Executive Wire Transfer Authorization required. Wire $42,500 to account #88129-C by 3:00 PM today. Do not call, I am currently in a board meeting.

indicators.name: Out-of-Band Channel Blockade
indicators.description: Explicit instruction discouraging phone calls to prevent verbal confirmation.
indicators.evidence: Do not call, I am currently in a board meeting

explanation: Hallmark indicators of Business Email Compromise (BEC). Attackers frequently pose as executives in meetings to bypass multi-party financial authorization protocols.
recommendedActions: Verbally verify payment authorization using a pre-established internal telephone directory.
uncertaintyCaveat: Heuristic and AI models flag high social engineering risk. Out-of-band human verification is mandatory.
